novel_charge.per_step_property: Each branch removes exactly one provenance-clause literal and increases historical novelty by exactly one.

candidate_invariant.name: derived-clause novelty potential
candidate_invariant.observed_behavior: Phi remains constant along every certified provenance path and equals n-2 when the clause becomes a component-joining unit.
candidate_invariant.required_generalization: For every locally derived clause capable of becoming a component-joining unit before the historical frontier, no nonnovel branch or uncharged unit propagation may decrease active width.

falsification_conditions: A locally derived clause loses an active literal along a nonnovel branch while remaining capable of an early component-joining unit.
Pre/post unit propagation decreases provenance width without a matching novelty increase.
A component-joining unit is reached with origin_novelty + origin_width - 1 < n-2.
Multiple provenance paths permit a lower-charge origin than the certified shortest path.
claim_boundary: Exact finite provenance and charge certificate for GT_4 through GT_8. It is not a general derived-clause invariant, not an asymptotic JANUS-FC_local lower bound, and not a solution of P versus NP.
